Subject: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive (ML / Infra)

Hi Marcus / Ava,

Thanks again for the call this morning - really appreciate the context on your safety monitoring use case and the two pilot workflows you outlined. Per our discussion, the next best step is a technical deep dive with your ML and infra teams so we can:

- Walk through end-to-end architecture and where Redwood would sit in your pipeline
- Share performance/cost tradeoffs for the model sizes you mentioned
- Review security controls (VPC, KMS, audit logs) and data residency requirements
- Agree on a mutual action plan and next milestones

We typically schedule a 60-90 minute session for this. Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue, Jun 22: 10:00-11:30
- Wed, Jun 23: 14:00-15:30
- Thu, Jun 24: 09:00-10:30

Please let me know which works for your team or share a preferred slot via this calendar link: https://calendly.com/redwood/marissa-deep-dive-60

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions + success criteria (10m)
2) Horizon Health architecture and current bottlenecks (15m)
3) Redwood technical overview: runtime, routing, caching (20m)
4) Deep dive: inference performance, model variants, quantization options (20m)
5) Security & compliance: VPC, KMS, audit logs, data retention (15m)
6) Open questions & action items (10m)

Attached: draft Mutual Action Plan and a short Redwood technical overview - feel free to circulate to the engineers.

If you confirm a slot I will loop in our SE (Dylan Brooks) and Camila (Solutions PM) who will join the deep dive.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: Horizon-MAP-v1.xlsx, redwood-technical-overview.pdf

Thanks Dylan - appreciate the prep list. Quick answers:
- Architecture: ingest -> redact/normalize -> feature extraction -> model inference -> results store. I attached a short internal note to the Drive folder (link below) with more details.
- Models: pilot will run a 13B model and we may evaluate a 70B variant later. Avg prompt length ~350 tokens.
- QPS: steady-state ~8 reqs/sec (bursty to 25 reqs/sec during peak).
- Network: private VPC peering with egress restrictions; must support routing through our transit gateway.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Horizon-Prep

We'll join Tue 22 10:00. Marcus + Ava + two infra engineers (names to follow). Looking forward to it.
